source: Derived index of retained genuine AWS observations, not fabricated wire responses

measured_contract.omitted_input: Admitted and actual S3 Source -> S3 Deploy execution Succeeded.
measured_contract.supplied_json: Input contained name pointing to uniquely never-created pipeline, Marker=input-marker variable override, old S3 source version override, and clientRequestToken. Both supplied schedules executed ARN-named pipeline with Marker=default-marker and latest S3 source version; all deployed ZIP bytes matched latest source.
measured_contract.token: Identical supplied clientRequestToken on two schedules produced distinct actual pipeline execution IDs; supplied token did not deduplicate these executions.
measured_contract.plaintext: Non-JSON Input admitted and actual recovery execution Succeeded; no JSON parsing requirement in measured CodePipeline templated target.
measured_contract.trigger: StartPipelineExecution with scheduler assumed-role ARN, not CloudWatchEvent.
measured_contract.current_role_deny: Explicit deny codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution on exact pipeline produced no new pipeline executions and AccessDeniedException DLQ message. Original Input was not DLQ body; native transformed body was {"Name":"stackd-schedcp-52d841b2fbde"}.
measured_contract.recovery: Restoring current role permission produced successful actual scheduled execution and deployed latest ZIP bytes.
measured_contract.foreign_account_admission: DISABLED own-account schedule targeting ARN with account 111122223333 and unique own pipeline name was admitted. No foreign invocation or foreign resources were used; runtime account-routing behavior is unobserved.
measured_contract.malformed_resource_admission: Updating disabled target ARN with /invalid appended to pipeline name returned ValidationException: Provided Arn is not in correct format.

bounds_and_cleanup.cleanup: Deleted all six exact-owned schedules, group, pipeline, every listed owned object version/delete marker and bucket, both inline policies/roles and DLQ. Exact get/head absence requests retained, plus empty version listing before bucket deletion. No owned resource remains.

prior_setup_failures.failure: Initial Source PermissionError before any schedules; fully deleted and absence-verified.
Initial Source PermissionError after adding documented object-tagging reads/KMS scope; still before any schedules; fully deleted and absence-verified.

bounds_and_cleanup.corrected_prerequisite: CodePipeline artifact prefix need not equal full pipeline name. Final role restricted listed S3 object actions to exact newly-owned bucket/* and KMS via same-account regional S3 with owned-bucket-object encryption context. This setup succeeded.

limits: Foreign-account runtime and foreign-region behavior were not observed; disabled admission is not runtime parity evidence.
No CloudTrail events captured. Trigger attribution is actual ListPipelineExecutions API output.
Statements about ignored Input apply to the retained omitted, JSON override and plaintext cases; unknown input cases remain unmeasured.
This is native boto3 wire calibration; local signed AWS SDK Go v2 verification is separate.
